### Featured Projects

#### 📚 [Library Management System](https://github.com/jawahralharbi/Library-Management-System)

A PostgreSQL database designed so bad data can't get in: business rules live in the database itself, not just the app.

- 11 fully normalized tables
- PL/pgSQL triggers & functions enforcing the rules
- Borrowing analytics with CTEs and window functions

<sub>PostgreSQL · PL/pgSQL · SQL</sub>

#### ☀️ [PVision](https://github.com/jawahralharbi/PVision)

Full-stack app that predicts solar panel output from live weather data, with Llama 3.1 explaining each prediction.

- Random Forest, **37% lower error** than baseline
- MAE 0.97 kW · R² 0.869
- 196K+ record dataset

<sub>Python · scikit-learn · Streamlit · Hugging Face</sub>

#### 🧠 Gray Matters <sub>· 🔒 private research</sub>

A Deep Learning-Based System for Early Detection of Cognitive Decline: a research and development project building a clinical decision support system from brain MRI scans, with a focus on interpretability.

<sub>PyTorch · CNNs · Few-Shot Learning · Medical Imaging</sub>
